test_title: PYST 26: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - English (Held On: 20th Sep 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Choose the most suitable option to replace the highlighted part:

I object **to his conduct**.
solution:
The correct answer is '**against his conduct**'.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The preposition "**against**" is used to express opposition or objection. Hence, "**against his conduct**" is the correct choice.
